answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Reaching the meadow of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, idle agents bleed standing. The signal holds work receipts rather than names, so the dawn of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
